name: Paragon
intro: The Paragon pathway advances through science, artifacts, machinery and craftsmanship. Its users turn technical mastery into increasingly sophisticated supernatural tools.

meter.name: Invention
meter.gain: Device attacks and Alchemical Fire marks
meter.full: Alchemical Fire grants the owner a shield; a living device’s next marked shot gains DEF penetration

ability.name: Mechanical Precision
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Mechanical Precision — +10 percentage points accuracy; +10% Piercing direct-damage resistance, +10% Corrosion direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Crafted Blade
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Crafted Blade — Deals 135% INT Piercing damage (25% base DEF bypass); +20% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 1 turn.

ability.name: Runic Shield
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Runic Shield — Grants a 20% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Alchemical Fire
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Alchemical Fire — Deals 160% INT Fire damage (25% base DEF bypass); Keep the Fire damage. A living device ignores 20% DEF on its next landed shot against the marked target. At 100 charge, also gain 10% Max HP shield. Devices enter free when prepared and stay for the battle.; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Matter Fortification
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Matter Fortification — +25% DEF for 2 turns; Reduces incoming physical damage by 20% until your next turn after shields; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Alchemical Overclock
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Alchemical Overclock — Stores +35% damage for your next landed damaging-skill hit; +25% SPEED for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Energy Cannon
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Energy Cannon — Deals 240% INT Physical damage (25% base DEF bypass); +40% DEF bypass on this cast; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 70 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Divine Metallurgy
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Divine Metallurgy — Grants a 30% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Creation Engine
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Creation Engine — Deals 330% INT Magic damage (25% base DEF bypass); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: God of Crafting
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: God of Crafting — Deals 410% INT True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 120 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
